name: Flwr Bar CC - 3 Gram THCA Disposable - Papaya BX - Indica
description:
Papaya BX

Hand-crafted Terpene Profile: Ripe tropical papaya meets juicy mango with a splash of bright citrus and a smooth, earthy finish—Papaya BX is lush, exotic, and full of character. The inhale delivers a wave of sweet tropical fruit, while the exhale brings forward subtle citrus and earthy depth. The experience starts with a warm, euphoric lift before settling into a soothing, laid-back body calm that feels smooth from start to finish.

Housed in a color-coded and strain specific Flwr Bar 3 Gram THCA Disposable with heavy-duty hardware, premium hemp-derived distillate, and childproof packaging. Powered by cutting-edge Nano THCA for faster absorption, stronger effects, and a boutique-crafted experience built for those who want flavor as unforgettable as their high.

Details

• Papaya BX (Indica)

• 3 Gram Disposable Vape

• THCA Cold Cure Live Rosin Blend

How to Use

• 5 clicks - ON/OFF

• 2 Clicks - preheat

• Connect device to USB-C cord for charging. Inhale to activate device.

• USB-C cord not included.

Cannabinoids

• Nano THCA

• Delta-8

What is Cold Cure Live Rosin?

Cold Cure Live Rosin: refined flavor and consistency, naturally

Cold Cure Live Rosin begins with solventless live rosin made from fresh-frozen material to preserve its naturally occurring cannabinoids and terpenes. After pressing, the rosin is cured at controlled, cool temperatures, allowing its texture and terpene profile to develop without the use of chemical solvents. The result is a smooth, stable concentrate with a rich aroma, full-bodied flavor, and a consistency ideal for a premium vaping experience.

What is Nano THC?

Nano THC offers faster absorption, stronger effects

Nano THC is THC that’s been broken down into microscopic, water-soluble particles for faster absorption and stronger effects. By making THC more bioavailable, nano technology allows your body to feel the benefits quicker and with greater consistency compared to traditional THC.

What is THCA?

THCA Is The Precursor To THC

This enigmatic cannabinoid holds immense potential, offering a multitude of therapeutic benefits. THCA, the precursor to THC, is a cannabinoid found in the hemp plant that converts to Delta-9 when decarboxylated (heated). When combined with other cannabinoids, such as Delta-8, the results will leave you feeling a sense of calm.

What is Delta-8?

Delta 8 is made from pure CBD

 Delta-8, the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. Delta-8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

Full Panel COA

Papaya BX

THCA Disclaimer

This product is not available for shipment to the following states: Hawaii, Idaho, Minnesota, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, and Vermont.
